data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in the net provision for claims includes adverse prior year development of GBP 0.7m (2016: GBP 1.1m adverse). Prior year claims development is analysed by line of business in the table below.
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 the syndicate had gross claims outstanding of GBP 141.815m. During 2017 there was a small gross prior-year strengthening of reserves (gross movement ~GBP 1.221m), resulting in net adverse prior year development of GBP 0.720m. The prior year movements were concentrated in liability and property-related classes (notably third party liability and fire & other damage to property), partly offset by favourable development in marine and miscellaneous lines and reinsurance recoveries. No specific named catastrophe is cited as the principal driver of the prior year movement.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in the net provision for claims includes adverse prior year development of GBP 0.7m (2016: GBP 1.1m adverse).
The loss for the financial year is attributable to catastrophe and risk losses incurred during the year, and is reflected in the increased net combined ratio of 117.1% (2016: 117.0%).
data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year movement taken from the 'Change in prior year provisions' (gross) line in the Technical Provisions note. The report displays numbers in parentheses for 'adverse' movements; interpretation applied so that the gross movement (1,221) is treated as a strengthening of GBP 1.221m (consistent with the net adverse GBP 0.720m disclosed). Lob mapping for 'Miscellaneous' and the 'Reinsurance' row required approximate mapping to standard LOBs (mapped to 'Professional Lines' and 'Treaty' respectively) - these mappings have lower confidence. All monetary figures in the report are presented in GBP 000; amounts here converted to millions. No specific named catastrophe events affecting prior year development are identified in the report.
